policy_notes: Manual overrides always win at runtime.
User screenshot exceptions override generated defaults.
Roman numerals are whole tokens; ambiguous I/V/X and known letter-based brands are protected.
First-game numbering is inferred from numbered siblings in the whole database, not installed folders.
Release-order positions are generated from metadata, not per-game SortingTitle strings.
Cross-title franchise membership and regional equivalence require semantic metadata.
Inferred subtitle families require complete title-checked date metadata.
Metadata dates are not universally verified; missing/conflicting records appear in the coverage report.
PS2-only ordinal positions are not official franchise numbering.
